propositions: At search exhaustion, banked evidence carries `evidence_sufficient:false` marker instead of bare `met=false`, distinguishing absence-of-evidence from positive refutation
Preserve-on-overwrite behavior ensures fallback-banked insufficient markers survive markerless successor harvests while genuine refutation (bare met=false) replaces the marker

Rendering seams (reconcile_verdict, close_precheck, _render_verdict_text, merge_finalizer_with_bank) emit evidence-insufficiency messaging and remediation guidance instead of unmet-criteria verdicts when the marker is present
Framework-set markers (never model-input) persist through schema validation, finalizer payload, and sidecar FAIL records via re-stamp enforcement from authoritative bank entries
Completion verifier stops producing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was not reached within search budget window
